news.title: Wells Fargo in talks with Kraken parent Payward for crypto trading liquidity
news.summary: The discussions would see Payward supply liquidity for crypto trading as major banks deepen their involvement in digital assets.

news.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
news.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

news.title: Grayscale says crypto ETF market is entering new phase as Zcash ETF tops $1 billion
news.summary: Grayscale's Krista Lynch says SEC listing standards cover about 15 tokens, letting crypto ETF issuers get selective beyond bitcoin and ether.

news.title: Hunter Biden confirms LAPTOP token ‘not a rug pull,’ just trolling Trumps
news.summary: “Trump’s coin was max extraction, and I wanted to troll every grift like it,“ said Hunter Biden in a breakdown of the memecoin launch and fallout.

news.title: Sui tunnels hit 40.6M TPS in live AI agent test
news.summary: The layer-1 blockchain said its programmable offchain tunnels reached the milestone during a live stress test designed to simulate high-frequency activity between AI agents.

news.title: Ethereum researcher Justin Drake calls for ‘bunker mode’ planning over private key recovery risk
news.summary: Justin Drake recommended moving crypto assets to fresh addresses that keep their public keys hidden behind a hash.

news.title: Hunter Biden says LAPTOP market maker should ‘buy it all back and burn it’
news.summary: A commissioned report details thin liquidity and market-maker-linked gains during LAPTOP’s launch.

news.title: Polygon taps TRON’s $94 billion stablecoin supply for seamless cross-border transfers
news.summary: Polygon said businesses can also move the world’s largest stablecoin USDT between TRON and EVM networks without connecting to a wallet provider, bridge or fiat-ramp operator.

news.title: Tether, Kazakhstan cenbank mull tenge stablecoin and asset tokenization
news.summary: The agreement will explore a tenge-backed stablecoin pilot and a framework for tokenizing real-world assets as Kazakhstan expands its digital asset industry.

news.title: House Finance panel chair says regulator actions on crypto ‘fall short’ of CLARITY bill
news.summary: Representative French Hill hopes lawmakers could pass a cryptocurrency market structure bill before the next session of Congress in 2027 as SEC and CFTC actions weren’t sufficient

news.title: Coinbase brings global crypto derivatives liquidity to US with Deribit integration
news.summary: US institutions will gain access to Deribit’s options and perpetual futures through Coinbase, with US retail options expected later this year.

news.title: Gate bets all-in-one money app is crypto’s biggest consumer trend this year and next
news.summary: Gate rebrands around Gate Money, which combines accounts, asset conversion, savings and card payments as the exchange broadens beyond its trading base.

news.title: Bitcoin price drops to $82.7K October low as bond sell-off resumes on Iran nerves
news.summary: Bitcoin fell below $83,000 to reach month-to-date lows as stocks reversed after all-time highs and bond yields spiked higher.

news.title: Crypto Long & Short: Zcash and the case for privacy in the age of AI
news.summary: AI has made it cheap to link wallet addresses to the people behind them, and the permanence of the blockchain means records don’t age out. news.title: Tether tapped by Kazakhstan’s central bank to explore stablecoin and tokenization
news.summary: The National Bank of Kazakhstan said it will study a local currency-linked stablecoin and tokenized real-world assets with Tether.

news.title: Moody’s gives Sky Protocol B3 rating as institutional interest in USDS grows
news.summary: Moody's assigned Sky a B3 issuer rating with a stable outlook, its first rating of a stablecoin protocol. Sky is also rated B- by S&P.

news.title: Quantum computers threaten exposed private keys rather than blockchains, Europol warns
news.summary: EU law enforcement agencies urged developers, exchanges, and users to initiate phased post-quantum migrations immediately to prevent future unauthorized fund transfers.

news.title: Ether is about to lose a steady buyer as Tom Lee says Bitmine will stop token purchases
news.summary: Tom Lee said Bitmine will be “done stacking” once it owns 5% of ETH, setting an end date to an accumulation streak that began in mid-2025 and made the company the world's largest Ethereum treasury.

news.title: Crypto trading giant GSR's new vault business is a $100M bet on onchain credit
news.summary: The firm is putting its own capital into stablecoin and tokenized gold vaults as institutional finance moves further onchain.

news.title: Chasing 100x tokens is game of ‘irrational exuberance,’ says Polymarket CEO
news.summary: Some traders are looking for more predictable prediction market opportunities, rather than playing “hot potato” with the next 100x gem, according to Polymarket’s Shayne Coplan.

news.title: Swift blockchain ledger requires key internal layers, Taurus co-founder warns
news.summary: Banks need their own permissioned ledger, wallet tools and smart-contract capabilities before they can use Swift’s tokenized-deposit network, Taurus’s Lamine Brahimi said.

news.title: Crypto card access doesn’t match global demand, Tangem says
news.summary: Crypto card demand can be stronger where access is harder, Tangem says, as it expands its Visa payment offering, allowing users to spend from its self-custodial wallet.

news.title: Here’s what bitcoin needs to break above $87,000
news.summary: Your day-ahead look for Oct. 7, 2026

news.title: NEAR’s Polosukhin sees shrinking need for centralized exchanges as onchain tools expand
news.summary: NEAR co-founder Illia Polosukhin said users no longer need centralized exchanges for "a lot" of crypto activity.

news.title: Live updates: Bitcoin edges up from worst levels as yields pull back
news.summary: Ether underperformed, losing 6% after Tom Lee said Bitmine would soon stop purchasing additional ETH.

news.title: Bitcoin’s recovery stalls just short of rescuing its last underwater cohort
news.summary: Yearly buyer cohorts and U.S. spot ETF investors offer a map of potential support and resistance as bitcoin retreats below $84,000.

news.title: Liquidations jump to $547 million as oil rally hits crypto market
news.summary: Bitcoin fell below $84,000 as oil climbed on Iranian tanker attacks, while smaller tokens fell harder and liquidations rose to $547 million.

news.title: Trump-backed WLFI plans USD1 payments for online businesses
news.summary: World Liberty Financial outlined plans to bring USD1 to major online platforms as Mesh announced a payments partnership scheduled to roll out this quarter.

news.title: Wall Street wealth creation model is unsustainable for most participants: Hyperliquid CEO
news.summary: Early Wall Street wealth-creation opportunities remain inaccessible to retail participants, but Hyperliquid’s perpetual contracts aim to democratize access, according to its CEO.

news.title: ‘Old money’ has stronger Bitcoin ‘diamond hands,’ says BingX exec
news.summary: BingX strategy chief Kevin Lee says wealthy investors are taking a longer-term approach to Bitcoin, though family-office crypto exposure remains limited.

news.title: Jito’s JTX plans mobile app this fall, eyes perps integration later this winter
news.summary: Jito’s JTX plans a mobile app, equities feature, and perpetual futures as it expands beyond spot trading on Solana.

news.title: Crypto liquidations hit $550M as Bitcoin price dips below $84K
news.summary: Bitcoin fell 2.3% in two hours amid suspicion over the appearance of leveraged BTC short positions on Hyperliquid.

news.title: Rain is seeking a national trust bank charter to bypass third-party banks
news.summary: The stablecoin payments company’s proposed New York trust bank would custody digital assets and dollars, manage stablecoin reserves and issue and redeem dollar-backed tokens.

news.title: Bitcoin ETFs rebound with $119M inflow as Ether extends losses
news.summary: Bitcoin ETFs returned to net inflows with $119 million on Tuesday despite falling prices, while Ether funds reached a six-session outflow streak totaling $408 million.

news.title: Robinhood adds $25 million of bitcoin to its balance sheet
news.summary: Robinhood has added bitcoin worth $25 million to its balance sheet, senior vice president and general manager of crypto and international, told the Starting Block Wednesday.

news.title: Bitmine sets 5% Ether supply ‘hard cap’ as accumulation target nears
news.summary: Tom Lee said Bitmine will not accumulate Ether past 5% of the supply, turning the company’s target into a ceiling.

news.title: ‘Every single exchange’ will have to adopt public blockchain infrastructure to compete, Hyperliquid Policy Center CEO says
news.summary: Chervinsky says that beyond regulated perps, onchain markets need to enter the U.S. regulatory perimeter, a step he expects will happen soon.

news.title: Russia clears first crypto exchanges, custodians under new law
news.summary: Russia registered its first crypto exchanges and custodians, including its largest bank, Sberbank, which plans to launch crypto products on Dec. 1.

news.title: Down but not out. Bitcoin's stair-step bullish trajectory is still intact
news.summary: Bitcoin dipped to around $84,200 on Wednesday but stayed inside its recent range, keeping the broader bullish stair-step trajectory intact.

news.title: DOJ invokes Bitcoin Fog ruling in potential blow to Roman Storm acquittal bid
news.summary: Prosecutors say a recent Bitcoin Fog appeals court ruling supports their argument that Tornado Cash activity in Manhattan was enough to establish venue for parts of Roman Storm’s case in New York.

news.title: Robinhood adds $25 million worth of bitcoin to balance sheet as it deepens crypto push
news.summary: Robinhood SVP Johann Kerbrat says the purchase was intended to signal the company's commitment to the crypto sector.

news.title: U.S. government moves over $100 million in BTC and BNB. A sale hasn't been confirmed
news.summary: Wallets linked to the U.S. government moved millions in crypto on Tuesday, according to data tracked by Arkham.

news.title: Kalshi’s 15-min gold markets overtake Ether just weeks after launch
news.summary: Gold recorded 542 million contracts and an estimated $5 million in fees in September, surpassing Ether’s 318 million contracts and $2.6 million, though Bitcoin remained far ahead.

news.title: Pudgy Penguins’ Abstract becomes second Ethereum layer 2 to shut in a week
news.summary: The consumer-focused blockchain will close Dec. 15 after Igloo spent tens of millions supporting it, days after Blast said its own network was no longer worth operating.

news.title: Cardano gives token issuers power to freeze, seize and restrict assets
news.summary: The new standard is aimed at regulated stablecoins, funds and bonds whose issuers need identity checks, sanctions controls and other transfer rules built into the asset itself.

news.title: Bitcoin dips below $84,000 as oil jumps on Iranian tanker attacks
news.summary: Bitcoin briefly broke under the level analysts flagged as the point where sellers take over. Oil and the dollar both climbed.

news.title: Bitcoin briefly slides below $84,000 as crypto long liquidations reach $487 million
news.summary: Crypto liquidations amounted to $555.6 million over the past 24 hours, including $487.2 million in long positions, according to CoinGlass.

news.title: Coinbase Pro to return; Deribit integration creates Coinbase Global Exchange
news.summary: Coinbase plans to relaunch Coinbase Pro by year-end and has completed its Deribit integration, creating Coinbase Global Exchange.

news.title: Bitcoin.de trading remains halted as German regulator rejects MiCA application
news.summary: Trading on the platform has largely been suspended since June as its operator awaited MiCA authorization, with the company now looking to regulated partners to restart services.

news.title: Pudgy Penguins-backed Abstract to shut down after ‘tens of millions’ in losses
news.summary: Igloo CEO Luca Netz said the company funded Abstract for 18 months but still failed to find product-market fit despite attracting major brands and a community of millions.

news.title: Conduit sues Tether over allegedly freezing $2.8M without explanation
news.summary: The lawsuit alleged that Tether froze USDt funds in a Conduit wallet tied to an investigation launched by Brazilian authorities in 2024.

news.title: Winklevoss-backed Zcash ETF files with SEC for Nasdaq listing
news.summary: The proposed fund would hold ZEC directly, with Gemini Trust serving as custodian and Winklevoss Capital affiliates eyeing up to a $100 million investment.

news.title: Pudgy Penguins-backed Ethereum L2 Abstract to shut down after losing ‘tens of millions’
news.summary: Abstract, the Pudgy Penguins-backed Ethereum L2, will shut down on Dec. 15. Users must bridge assets off before then.

news.title: UK names 6 banks to lead first digitally native government bond
news.summary: The DIGIT pilot will test distributed ledger technology and onchain settlement for UK sovereign debt, with issuance expected by the first quarter of 2027.

news.title: Russia’s digital ruble accounts top 220K in first month, nearly 4X central bank forecast
news.summary: The digital ruble’s early uptake comes as BRICS nations explore linking their digital currencies for cross-border trade and payments.

news.title: Bill aims at stopping US lawmaker bets on their own elections ahead of midterms
news.summary: The No Betting on Your Own Race Act will not be addressed before the 2026 US midterms as Congress is on recess until after the election.

news.title: Conduit sues Tether over $2.76 million freeze, says it has ‘no legal entitlement’ to funds
news.summary: Conduit is suing Tether in NY federal court, alleging the USDT issuer froze $2.76 million of its funds for over a year without explanation.

news.title: Peter Thiel-backed Founders Fund leads a $5 million token buy in crypto collateral protocol Anvil
news.summary: Pantera Capital and Bullish also participated in the ANVL purchase as Anvil rolls out software designed to make its collateral protocol easier for businesses to integrate.

news.title: Crypto is expanding the boundaries of what can be priced
news.summary: The future of crypto may therefore depend less on creating the next novel asset and more on building the infrastructure required to price a growing universe of existing ones, argues Altius co-founder and CEO Annabelle Huang.

news.title: Winklevoss group seeks to launch Zcash ETF with 0.25% fee, proposed WINK ticker
news.summary: Winklevoss Asset Services filed for a spot Zcash ETF under ticker WINK, with Gemini as custodian and a 0.25% fee, rivaling Grayscale's ZCSH.

news.title: OKX draws investment from StanChart, Circle, Ripple as it pushes beyond crypto exchange roots
news.summary: The exchange is increasingly aiming to position itself as a global financial tech platform spanning crypto, payments and tokenized assets, following an investment and joint venture with NYSE parent ICE.

news.title: Solana treasury DeFi Development authorizes CHAD preferred stock buyback program
news.summary: Solana treasury firm DeFi Development approved an open-ended program to repurchase CHAD preferred stock if it trades below its $10 par value.

news.title: Brevan Howard to use Ripple Prime for multi-asset brokerage, clearing and financing
news.summary: Ripple Prime will provide prime brokerage, clearing and financing to Brevan Howard, deepening a tie that began with its Ripple investment.

news.title: Polymarket rolls out V2 upgrade with single ERC-1155 positions contract, pUSD collateral
news.summary: Polymarket rolls out Protocol V2, replacing its legacy Gnosis-based setup with a single ERC-1155 positions contract and pUSD collateral.

news.title: Arbitrum joins Paxos-led stablecoin group Global Dollar to capture digital dollar growth
news.summary: The Ethereum layer-2 is backing Paxos-issued USDG to earn a share of reserve income as new stablecoin alliances compete for distribution, users and reserve economics.

news.title: Fortitude expands Zcash mining push with up to $100 million equipment commitment
news.summary: Fortitude secured priority access to BITMAIN’s next-generation Zcash miners as it expands capacity and increases financing from DCG.

news.title: Self-styled 'Godfather' gets 6 years in prison for $37 million Meta fraud scheme
news.summary: Adam Iza’s sentence runs concurrently with a 15-year term imposed last month for his role in an attempted bitcoin robbery.

news.title: Rep. Don Davis introduces bill to stop federal candidates trading prediction market contracts tied to their own elections
news.summary: Don Davis introduced legislation barring federal candidates and their families from trading prediction contracts tied to their own elections.

news.title: Spiko raises $90 million to expand tokenized cash funds across markets
news.summary: Spiko raised $90 million in Series B funding to scale its $2.7 billion tokenized cash fund business and expand into new markets.

news.title: ZachXBT says he fronted $349,700 to infiltrate alleged Chinese launderers tied to Lazarus, Bybit hack
news.summary: Posing as a client, ZachXBT said he gathered intelligence that helped freeze funds tied to the $1.5 billion Bybit hack.
